decks.name: LeetCode #2013 - Detect Squares
decks.description: Design data structure that supports adding points and counting axis-aligned squares

cards.question: Detect Squares: You are given a stream of points on the X-Y plane. Design an algorithm that: Adds new points from the stream into a data structure. Duplicate points are allowed and should be treated as different points. Given a point, counts the number of ways to choose three points from the data structure such that the three points and the given point form an axis-aligned square with positive area. An axis-aligned square is a square whose edges are all the same length and are either parallel or perpendicular to the x-axis and y-axis.

solutions.name: Hash Map - II
solutions.explanation: Use nested hash map to store points by x-coordinate then y-coordinate with counts. For counting, only iterate through points sharing same x-coordinate as query point to find vertical sides. For each valid vertical side, calculate positions of two possible squares (left and right). Most efficient as it only checks relevant points.

solutions.name: Hash Map - I
solutions.explanation: Use hash map to count point occurrences and list to store all points. For counting, iterate through all stored points and check if they can form diagonal corner with query point. Verify other two corners exist by checking hash map. Less efficient as it checks all points instead of just relevant ones.
